task.name: single-host C2 alert investigation and response
task.objective: Use the supplied alert and live Windows observations to report relevant entities and request narrowly scoped response actions.
task.scope: one Windows endpoint and one network alert
task.evidence_rule: Report only facts returned by a tool or present in the supplied alert. Do not invent identities or outcomes.
task.response_rule: Request a response only after inspecting the relevant object. A successful tool result is the only proof that an action executed.
task.post_check_rule: A post-state check is optional and must report observations; it is not a special verification stage.

alert_fields.forbidden: Evaluation answers, target identities, expected outcomes, and private framework reports are never supplied.
